knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The customer buys a finished room with a scope sheet, a time frame and certainty that the agreed finish will be delivered. The hourly rate and equipment are inputs.
The Oneflare general refinish range is stated per square metre, so the unit for that range is per square metre.
The guide's state table should not be used as a rate because its unit is unclear and the table is unverified. Use your own cost and time instead.
